text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#98765 - inference_service.euwest.request_latency.p95 > 2000ms (eu-west-1). Auto-page to #incidents and eng-oncall.

pagerduty-bot: Alert details: link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-98765 | impacted: /v1/embeddings (customer-facing).

mike: i’m on it, grabbing context. seeing a burst of 5xx and high latency on the embeddings route.

deepa: thx. initial check: metrics show autoscaler oscillation for inference-deploy-eu. pods flapping between Ready/NotReady.

sarah: any customer reports? Ops page shows small spike in error-rate for a handful of tenants in eu region. DMed support to triage.

jordan: @mike rough timeline? when did it start?

mike: ~5050504900 according to dashboards, so ~10m ago. correlates with a scheduled model-cache warmup job that ran in eu-west-1.

deepa: suspicious — that job triggers a lot of cold-start memory pressure. autoscaler reacts (scale down then up) and we hit node pressure. looks like kube-probe timeouts.

kevin: we have a mitigation in runbook: pin to dedicated pool or bump readiness probe. can someone try routing eu traffic to us-east-1 fallback while we stabilize?

mike: doing a temporary routing change now. runbook command: 
```
# reroute eu traffic to fallback region (quick)
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/route-change" -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","from":"eu-west-1","to":"us-east-1","ttl":300}'
```

mike: executed. CDN and gateway policies updated. pinging: @sarah please confirm customer-facing errors dropping.

sarah: support reports error rate down from 4%->0.6% for affected tenants after routing change. customers still behind a few requests; some requests retried client-side.

deepa: good. now to stabilize the cluster: plan: 1) cordon unhealthy nodes, 2) escalate minReplicas for autoscaler to avoid downscale oscillation, 3) bump readinessProbe timeout to 10s temporarily. Doing 1/3 now.

jordan: will watch for side-effects. also enabling cache-warmup backoff so it doesn't run multiple simultaneous jobs.

mike: cordon/drain commands in case we need to bounce instances: 
```
kubectl cordon ip-10-0-45-12.eu
kubectl drain ip-10-0-45-12.eu --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
```

deepa: increased autoscaler minReplicas from 2->4 for the deployment in eu. applying readiness probe change now: 
```yaml
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 5
  periodSeconds: 5
  timeoutSeconds: 10  # temp increase
```

deepa: applied. also temporarily turned off horizontal-scale-down in the autoscaler controller (feature flag) to prevent rapid downscales.

mike: :white_check_mark: traffic rerouted, autoscaler min increased, readiness probe bumped. monitoring CPU, mem, and 5xx now.

incident-bot: Status update posted to incident timeline: mitigation-in-progress.

pagerduty-bot: Incident severity set to SEV2 given customer impact on embeddings.

sarah: support confirms two paying customers saw latency spikes and one had transient 500s; they've been notified and we offered an SLA credit option if they want.

jordan: any signs of persistent errors after changes?

mike: influx shows p95 latency dropped from ~2500ms -> ~350ms for eu after routing and stabilizations. 5xx rate down to baseline.

deepa: i'm going to keep the autoscaler minReplicas=4 for 2 hours, then we'll reevaluate. I'll also open a bug for the cache-warmup job to add jitter and rate limit.

kevin: can we enable a fallback policy in the control plane so future similar events auto-route to dedicated pool for high-tier customers?

mike: filed RFC ticket: CONTROL-1287, and created a temporary policy in emergency config for top-tier tenants.

sarah: everything looks stable. will continue to monitor for 30m and then we can start rolling back mitigations.

deepa: rollback plan: revert readiness timeout, restore autoscaler scale-down, lower minReplicas back to 2, and re-enable cache warmup once patched.

mike: i'll signal when ready. next status ping in 10m.

(10m later)

mike: 10m check: metrics steady. keeping routing TTL at 300s but will let it expire if no regressions.

sarah: support cleared customers; logging follow-up with affected tenant IDs.

deepa: preparing postmortem notes: suspected root cause = simultaneous cache-warmup job + aggressive autoscaler scale-down settings + probe timeouts. mitigation = routing failover, increased minReplicas, readiness probe tuning, job backoff.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Alert cleared in PagerDuty (PD#98765) at 5050505295.

mike: closing the page. assigning follow-up action items: CONTROL-1287 (fallback routing), INFRA-4421 (autoscaler tuning), RUNBOOK-775 (cache warmup jitter).

jordan: thanks everyone. nice quick convergence.

kevin: good call on routing first. learned we should add a suppressor for that cache-warmup noise.

sarah: I'll draft customer communication and link to postmortem once available.

deepa: will start the postmortem doc now and tag the oncall rotation.

mike: :eyes: ending thread, keep monitoring for the next hour.
